name: DatenkranzGrz
title: genomDE GRZ metadata Datenkranz (logical model)
description: Logical model of the BfArM MV-GenomSeq GRZ metadata submission (schemas/grz/grz-schema.json), generated by scripts/schema_to_logical.py; the source type of the genomDE FML StructureMaps. Element names are the JSON property names, so a raw Datenkranz JSON instance parses against it unchanged. Dates are kept as strings (copied verbatim), enumerations are strings whose allowed values are listed in each element definition. Schema version 1.3.1.

element.short: genomDE GRZ metadata Datenkranz (logical model)
element.definition: Logical model of the BfArM MV-GenomSeq GRZ metadata submission (schemas/grz/grz-schema.json), generated by scripts/schema_to_logical.py; the source type of the genomDE FML StructureMaps. Element names are the JSON property names, so a raw Datenkranz JSON instance parses against it unchanged. Dates are kept as strings (copied verbatim), enumerations are strings whose allowed values are listed in each element definition. Schema version 1.3.1.
(no description in the BfArM schema)

element.short: Date of submission in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD
element.definition: Date of submission in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD Schema facets: format="date".

element.short: The options are: 'initial' for first submission, 'followup' is for followup submissions, 'addition' for additional su...
element.definition: The options are: 'initial' for first submission, 'followup' is for followup submissions, 'addition' for additional submission, 'correction' for correction Allowed values: 'initial', 'followup', 'addition', 'correction', 'test'.

element.short: The VNg of the genomic data of the index patient that will be reimbursed --> a unique 32-length byte code represented...
element.definition: The VNg of the genomic data of the index patient that will be reimbursed --> a unique 32-length byte code represented in a hex string of length 64. Schema facets: pattern="^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$".

element.short: A local case identifier of the Leistungserbringer to be able to track multiple submissions referring to the same inde...
element.definition: A local case identifier of the Leistungserbringer to be able to track multiple submissions referring to the same index patient

element.short: "GKV" gesetzliche Krankenversicherung, "PKV" private Krankenversicherung, "BG" Berufsgenossenschaft, "SEL" Selbstzahl...
element.definition: "GKV" gesetzliche Krankenversicherung, "PKV" private Krankenversicherung, "BG" Berufsgenossenschaft, "SEL" Selbstzahler, "SOZ" Sozialamt, "GPV" gesetzliche Pflegeversicherung, "PPV" private Pflegeversicherung, "BEI" Beihilfe, "SKT" Sonstige Kostenträger, "UNK" Unbekannt Allowed values: 'GKV', 'PKV', 'BG', 'SEL', 'SOZ', 'GPV', 'PPV', 'BEI', 'SKT', 'UNK'.

element.short: Institutional ID of the submitter according to §293 SGB V.
element.definition: Institutional ID of the submitter according to §293 SGB V. Schema facets: pattern="^[0-9]{9}$".

element.short: ID of the genomic data center in the format GRZXXXnnn.
element.definition: ID of the genomic data center in the format GRZXXXnnn. Schema facets: pattern="^(GRZ)[A-Z0-9]{3}[0-9]{3}$".

element.short: ID of the clinical data node in the format KDKXXXnnn.
element.definition: ID of the clinical data node in the format KDKXXXnnn. Schema facets: pattern="^(KDK)[A-Z0-9]{3}[0-9]{3}$".

element.short: Type of the disease
element.definition: Type of the disease Allowed values: 'oncological', 'rare', 'hereditary'.

element.short: whether additional persons are tested as well
element.definition: whether additional persons are tested as well Allowed values: 'single', 'duo', 'trio'.

element.short: whether tumor and/or germ-line are tested
element.definition: whether tumor and/or germ-line are tested Allowed values: 'tumor-only', 'tumor+germline', 'germline-only'.

element.short: Name of the sequencing lab.
element.definition: Name of the sequencing lab.

element.short: List of donors including the index patient.
element.definition: List of donors including the index patient.

element.short: A unique identifier given by the Leistungserbringer for each donor of a single, duo or trio sequencing; the donorPseu...
element.definition: A unique identifier given by the Leistungserbringer for each donor of a single, duo or trio sequencing; the donorPseudonym needs to be identifiable by the Leistungserbringer in case of changes to the consents by one of the donors. For Index patient use index.

element.short: Gender of the donor.
element.definition: Gender of the donor. Allowed values: 'male', 'female', 'other', 'unknown'.

element.short: Relationship of the donor in respect to the index patient, e.g
element.definition: Relationship of the donor in respect to the index patient, e.g. 'index', 'brother', 'mother', etc. Allowed values: 'mother', 'father', 'brother', 'sister', 'child', 'index', 'other'.
(no description in the BfArM schema)

element.short: Date of delivery
element.definition: Date of delivery. Date (in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD) on which the Model Project Declaration of Participation was presented to the patient, unless identical to the date of signature Schema facets: format="date".

element.short: Version of the declaration of participation
element.definition: Version of the declaration of participation. Name and version of the declaration of participation in the MV GenomSeq, e.g.: 'Patient Info TE Consent MVGenomSeq vers01'

element.short: Modules of the consent to MV: must have at least a permit of mvSequencing
element.definition: Modules of the consent to MV: must have at least a permit of mvSequencing

element.short: Consent or refusal to participate and consent, must be indicated for each option listed in the scope of consent.
element.definition: Consent or refusal to participate and consent, must be indicated for each option listed in the scope of consent. Allowed values: 'permit', 'deny'.

element.short: Date of signature of the pilot projects consent; in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD.
element.definition: Date of signature of the pilot projects consent; in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD. Schema facets: format="date".

element.short: Scope of consent or revocation.
element.definition: Scope of consent or revocation. Allowed values: 'mvSequencing', 'reIdentification', 'caseIdentification'.

element.short: Research consents
element.definition: Research consents. Multiple declarations of consent are possible! Must be assigned to the respective data sets. Schema alternatives/conditions: oneOf: (requires scope) | (requires noScopeJustification).

element.short: Schema version of de.medizininformatikinitiative.kerndatensatz.consent
element.definition: Schema version of de.medizininformatikinitiative.kerndatensatz.consent Allowed values: '2025.0.1', '2025.0.2', '2025.0.3', '2025.0.4', '2026.0.0', '2026.0.1'.

element.short: Date of the delivery of the research consent in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)
element.definition: Date of the delivery of the research consent in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) Schema facets: format="date".

element.short: Scope of the research consent in JSON format following the MII IG Consent v2025 FHIR schema
element.definition: Scope of the research consent in JSON format following the MII IG Consent v2025 FHIR schema.
